lines.zh: 低沉的脚步声在地表回荡。
lines.en: Low footsteps echo through the ground.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在行走中摩擦。
lines.en: Decaying skin rubs as it walks.

lines.zh: 它移动缓慢，但目光如炬。
lines.en: It moves slowly, but its gaze is intense.

lines.zh: 它的爪子轻轻触碰着地面。
lines.en: Its claws gently tap the ground.

lines.zh: 皮毛在每一步中抖动。
lines.en: Fur trembles with each step.

lines.zh: 它警惕地前行，留意四周。
lines.en: It cautiously advances, watching its surroundings.

lines.zh: 干枯的手指在抓挠着。
lines.en: Dry fingers scratch away.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地穿过阴暗的洞穴。
lines.en: It slowly moves through the dark cave.

lines.zh: 枯萎的肢体在移动。
lines.en: Withered limbs move slowly.

lines.zh: 它仿佛在寻找什么东西。
lines.en: It seems to be searching for something.

lines.zh: 我拖着长矛，嗅着你的足迹。
lines.en: I drag my spear and sniff along your tracks.

lines.zh: 隧道尽头，我的脚步回响。
lines.en: At the tunnel's end my footsteps echo.

lines.zh: 它的目光呆滞，像是迷失了方向。
lines.en: Its eyes are vacant, lost in thought.

lines.zh: 它似乎陷入了无尽的沉思。
lines.en: It appears lost in endless thought.

lines.zh: 腐烂的身躯静止不动。
lines.en: Its rotting body stands still.

lines.zh: 它偶尔抽搐一下，但很快恢复。
lines.en: It twitches occasionally, but recovers quickly.

lines.zh: 它像雕像一样一动不动。
lines.en: It stands still like a statue.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出微弱的呻吟。
lines.en: It emits a weak groan occasionally.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛空洞无神。
lines.en: Its eyes are hollow and lifeless.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤覆盖着它。
lines.en: Decaying skin covers it.

lines.zh: 它看起来像是从坟墓中爬出的。
lines.en: It looks like it crawled out of a grave.

lines.zh: 它发出的呻吟令人生畏。
lines.en: Its groans are terrifying.

lines.zh: 我靠着洞壁，打着瞌睡。
lines.en: I lean on the cave wall, dozing off.

lines.zh: 长矛搁在膝上，我数骨头。
lines.en: Spear on my knee, I count the bones.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Water drips from the roof; I can't be bothered to look.

lines.zh: 我在暗处磨着牙等天黑。
lines.en: In the dark I grind my teeth and wait for night.

lines.zh: 它突然注意到玩家的存在。
lines.en: It suddenly notices the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了怨恨。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with hatred.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地转向玩家。
lines.en: It slowly turns towards the player.

lines.zh: 它的目光像是穿透了时间。
lines.en: Its gaze seems to pierce through time.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶吼。
lines.en: It emits a low growl.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了杀意。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with murder.

lines.zh: 它低声嘶鸣，准备攻击。
lines.en: It lets out a low snarl, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它凝视着玩家，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It stares at the player, seemingly contemplating.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着危险的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with danger.

lines.zh: 新鲜的气味，从你身上来。
lines.en: A fresh scent comes off you.

lines.zh: 地精的鼻子比你的脚步快。
lines.en: A groglin's nose is quicker than your steps.

lines.zh: 别躲，地精的鼻子很灵。
lines.en: Don't hide; a groglin's nose is sharp.

lines.zh: 你背后的火把暴露了你。
lines.en: That torch behind you gives you away.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，把你看成猎物。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and see prey.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着洞里的泥。
lines.en: Your boots are caked with cave mud.

lines.zh: 抬头，我就在你头顶的岩缝。
lines.en: Look up — I'm in the crevice above you.

lines.zh: 你停下的地方，正是我的猎场。
lines.en: You stopped right in my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不清了！
lines.en: My vision is blurry!

lines.zh: 我脚下一滑，跌倒了！
lines.en: I slipped and fell down!

lines.zh: 我被箭射中了！
lines.en: I was hit by an arrow!

lines.zh: 我掉进水里了！
lines.en: I fell into the water!

lines.zh: 我被闪电击中了！
lines.en: I was struck by lightning!

lines.zh: 我饿得头昏眼花！
lines.en: I'm starved and dizzy!

lines.zh: 我掉入虚空了！
lines.en: I fell into the void!

lines.zh: 我中了魔法伤害！
lines.en: I was hit by magic!

lines.zh: 矛掉了，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: My spear dropped; I stoop to grab it.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子被打歪了！
lines.en: You've bent my nose crooked!

lines.zh: 你散发出的食物香气让它难以自控。
lines.en: The scent of your food tempts it out of control.

lines.zh: 它的目光被你手中的肉吸引。
lines.en: Its gaze is drawn to the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 你无意间发出的声音让它警觉。
lines.en: Its alertness is triggered by your accidental noise.

lines.zh: 它的双眼闪烁着对食物的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with hunger for food.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物让它停下了追踪。
lines.en: The food in your hand halts its pursuit.

lines.zh: 它闻到了你身上的食物气味。
lines.en: It detects the scent of food on you.

lines.zh: 你试图接近，却被它的叫声吓退。
lines.en: You try to approach but are deterred by its call.

lines.zh: 它被你丢弃的食物吸引而来。
lines.en: It's drawn by the food you discard.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物让它暂时放松警惕。
lines.en: The food in your hand momentarily relaxes its guard.

lines.zh: 它开始对你的食物产生兴趣。
lines.en: It begins to show interest in your food

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，两人都受到了惊吓。
lines.en: You collide with it, startling both parties.

lines.zh: 它的突然出现让你猝不及防。
lines.en: Its sudden appearance catches you off guard.

lines.zh: 你和它在黑暗中意外相遇。
lines.en: You inadvertently meet it in the dark.

lines.zh: 你试图避开它的攻击却失败了。
lines.en: You try to dodge its attack but fail.

lines.zh: 它的撞击力让你无法移动。
lines.en: Its force of impact immobilizes you.

lines.zh: 你被它碰了一下，但它似乎没注意到你。
lines.en: You bump into it, but it seems not to notice you.

lines.zh: 它撞开了你，自己却四处乱撞。
lines.en: It knocks you aside but stumbles about.

lines.zh: 你和它在狭窄的空间中碰撞。
lines.en: You collide in a narrow space.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上了你的身体。
lines.en: Its body collides with yours.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，却被它的攻击打断。
lines.en: You try to sidestep it but are interrupted by its attack.

lines.zh: 雌性昏沉地精猎手呼唤它的伴侣。
lines.en: The female Groglin Hunter calls for its mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找着配偶，发出求偶声。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, emitting a mating call.

lines.zh: 雄性昏沉地精猎手回应了它的求偶声。
lines.en: The male Groglin Hunter responds to its call.

lines.zh: 它在夜幕下寻找配偶。
lines.en: It searches for a mate under the night sky.

lines.zh: 雌性发出求偶信号，吸引雄性。
lines.en: The female emits a mating signal to attract the male.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴中找到了配偶。
lines.en: It finds a mate in the cave.

lines.zh: 雄性回应了雌性的求偶声。
lines.en: The male responds to the female's call.

lines.zh: 雌雄昏沉地精猎手相互靠近。
lines.en: The male and female Groglin Hunters approach each other.

lines.zh: 它们在月光下互相依偎。
lines.en: They cuddle in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它们在夜晚互相追逐，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: They chase each other through the night in search of a mate.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精猎手挥动长矛。
lines.en: Groglin Hunter swings its spear.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的叫声回荡在隧道中。
lines.en: The groglin hunter's scream echoes through the tunnel.

lines.zh: 这生物盯着你，眼中满是杀意。
lines.en: The groglin hunter stares at you with intent to kill.

lines.zh: 它啃食着昏沉地精的残骸。
lines.en: It feeds on the remains of groglin warriors.

lines.zh: 它的洞穴里堆满了战利品。
lines.en: Its den is filled with plunder.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的长矛闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: The groglin hunter's spear glimmers ominously.

lines.zh: 它发现了你，开始追猎。
lines.en: It spots you and begins to chase.

lines.zh: 地精猎手用爪子挖掘着泥土。
lines.en: The groglin hunter digs through the earth.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴中储存着粮食。
lines.en: It stores food in its den.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的叫声令人心悸。
lines.en: The groglin hunter's scream is chilling.

lines.zh: 你被地精猎手锁定为目标。
lines.en: You are targeted by the groglin hunter.

lines.zh: 它的双眼锁定你的位置。
lines.en: Its eyes are locked on you.

lines.zh: 你无法逃过它的视线。
lines.en: You can't escape its gaze.

lines.zh: 它准备发起致命一击。
lines.en: It prepares to strike.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的猎食本能被唤醒。
lines.en: Its hunting instincts are awakened.

lines.zh: 它悄悄接近，准备扑杀。
lines.en: It sneaks closer, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵寒意，它是你的敌人。
lines.en: You feel a chill, it's your enemy.

lines.zh: 它的视线从未离开过你。
lines.en: Its eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 你已被包围，无路可逃。
lines.en: You are surrounded, with no escape.

lines.zh: 它要将你撕成碎片。
lines.en: It's going to rip you apart.

lines.zh: 嗅到了，猎物就在前面。
lines.en: Sniffed it out — the prey is just ahead.

lines.zh: 我把长矛从肩上取下。
lines.en: I lift the spear off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我熟这些岔路。
lines.en: Run if you like; I know every fork.

lines.zh: 今晚的肉，归我。
lines.en: Tonight's meat is mine.

lines.zh: 我的同族正在围拢。
lines.en: My kin are closing in around you.

lines.zh: 你踏进了地精的地盘。
lines.en: You have stepped into groglin ground.

lines.zh: 你成为了它的目标。
lines.en: You are its target.

lines.zh: 矛尖对着你后颈那块软处。
lines.en: My spear tip points at the soft spot behind your neck.

lines.zh: 它的猎食目标是猎物。
lines.en: Its prey is what it hunts.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的猎物被选中。
lines.en: The groglin hunter selects its prey.

lines.zh: 它追踪着你的气息。
lines.en: It tracks your scent.

lines.zh: 你被它精准地瞄准。
lines.en: You are precisely targeted.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，将要攻击。
lines.en: It's ready to attack.

lines.zh: 地精猎手的视线锁定你。
lines.en: The groglin hunter's gaze is locked on you.

lines.zh: 你被盯上了，小心！
lines.en: You're being targeted, be careful!

lines.zh: 矛尖跟着你的胸口走。
lines.en: My spear tip follows your chest.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就扎穿你。
lines.en: One more step and I run you through.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就得倒下。
lines.en: I count to three and you go down.

lines.zh: 别指望洞口，那儿也有人。
lines.en: Don't count on the entrance; someone waits there too.

lines.zh: 你的铠甲挡不住矛尖。
lines.en: Your armor won't stop my spearpoint.

lines.zh: 我蹲低身子，蓄力待发。
lines.en: I crouch low, coiling for the strike.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙，闻到你怕。
lines.en: I lick my teeth; I smell your fear.

lines.zh: 影子先动，长矛随后。
lines.en: The shadow moves first, the spear follows.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁了，无处可去。
lines.en: You've backed to the rock face. Nowhere left.

lines.zh: 尖利的爪子划过你的皮肤。
lines.en: Sharp claws scratch your skin.

lines.zh: 冰冷的铁蹄踹向你的胸膛。
lines.en: Cold iron hooves stomp your chest.

lines.zh: 你感到它的利齿在你身上啃咬。
lines.en: You feel its sharp teeth gnawing on you.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精猎手的长矛贯穿了你的身体。
lines.en: The Groglin Hunter's spear pierces your body.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的斧头劈砍你的四肢。
lines.en: It swings its massive axe at your limbs.

lines.zh: 你被它的利爪抓得鲜血直流。
lines.en: You bleed heavily from its sharp claws.

lines.zh: 它用粗壮的拳头击打你的头部。
lines.en: It punches your head with its thick fist.

lines.zh: 冰冷的长矛贯穿你的腹部。
lines.en: The cold spear pierces your abdomen.

lines.zh: 它用巨剑砍断你的双臂。
lines.en: It chops your arms off with its greatsword.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精猎手的匕首割开你的喉咙。
lines.en: The Groglin Hunter's dagger slashes your throat.

lines.zh: 长矛一送，直取咽喉！
lines.en: The spear thrusts straight for your throat!

lines.zh: 爪子撕开你的衣甲！
lines.en: My claws tear through your gear!

lines.zh: 我从侧面扑上你的背！
lines.en: I leap onto your back from the side!

lines.zh: 这一矛，扎进你的腿！
lines.en: This spear takes your leg!

lines.zh: 牙齿咬住你的护腕！
lines.en: My teeth clamp on your bracer!

lines.zh: 我压上全身的力气砸下！
lines.en: I put my whole weight into the blow!

lines.zh: 夜晚的阴影中出现了一个昏沉地精猎手。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter appears in the shadows of night.

lines.zh: 你听到地精在远处聚集的声音。
lines.en: You hear the gnomes gathering in the distance.

lines.zh: 地面上裂开，昏沉地精猎手出现。
lines.en: The ground splits, and a Groglin Hunter appears.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精猎手从地下钻出。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter emerges from the ground.

lines.zh: 一只昏沉地精猎手从洞穴中爬出。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter crawls out of a cave.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精猎手从昏暗的角落中跃出。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter leaps out from the dark corner.

lines.zh: 地精猎手从树根中现身。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter appears from tree roots.

lines.zh: 地精从地下涌出，成为猎手。
lines.en: Gnomes surge up from the ground, becoming hunters.

lines.zh: 地精从地面裂口中冒出来。
lines.en: Gnomes pop out of ground fissures.

lines.zh: 一只昏沉地精猎手在洞穴入口现身。
lines.en: A Groglin Hunter appears at the cave entrance.

lines.zh: 洞壁裂缝里，我探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head from a crack in the cave wall.

lines.zh: 火光一暗，猎手来了。
lines.en: The torchlight dims: the hunter has come.

lines.zh: 地精的号叫在隧道传开。
lines.en: A groglin howl rolls down the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我从泥里爬起，抖落土。
lines.en: I rise from the mud and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 夜风带来血味，我出洞。
lines.en: The night wind carries blood; I leave the cave.

lines.zh: 长矛先出，我才现身。
lines.en: The spear comes out first, then me.

lines.zh: 石缝里的眼睛睁开了。
lines.en: Eyes open in the stone gap.

lines.zh: 我踩碎枯骨，走进光里。
lines.en: I crunch old bones and step into the light.

lines.zh: 我被火烧伤了！
lines.en: I'm burned by fire!

lines.zh: 我从高处摔了下来！
lines.en: I fell from a great height!

lines.zh: 我被淹死了！
lines.en: I drowned!

lines.zh: 我被爆炸震伤了！
lines.en: I was injured by an explosion!

lines.zh: 我中了投射物攻击！
lines.en: I was hit by a projectile!

lines.zh: 我被法术击中了！
lines.en: I was hit by a spell!

lines.zh: 我饿得虚弱不堪！
lines.en: I'm starved and weak!

lines.zh: 我被雷击中了！
lines.en: I was struck by lightning!

lines.zh: 脚下没了石壁，只有空。
lines.en: No stone wall underfoot — only emptiness.
